label: A01 · English question
method: Native/competent Indian English speaker; close mic; save 16 kHz mono.

label: A02 · Hindi question
method: Natural Hindi speaker; correct Devanagari reference (or selected format).

label: A03 · English statement
input_or_source: “I want to check my mutual fund investment returns.”
method: Slightly longer English sentence at normal speed.

label: A04 · Hindi request
input_or_source: “मुझे पिछले महीने की ट्रांज़ैक्शन हिस्ट्री चाहिए।”
method: Natural Hindi speaker with typical finance loanword.

label: A05 · Negation
input_or_source: “I do not want to sell these shares.”
method: Pronounce “not” clearly; separately flag negation correctness.

label: A06 · Polite request
input_or_source: “Could you please explain how an SIP works?”
method: Neutral volume and pacing; stable reference transcript.

label: B01 · 20 dB SNR
method: Add traffic noise at 20 dB SNR; loudness-adjust noise relative to active speech.

label: B02 · 10 dB SNR
method: Same traffic recording at 10 dB SNR; keep all other factors fixed.

label: B03 · 0 dB SNR
method: Same traffic recording at 0 dB SNR; save with no hard clipping.

label: B04 · Office babble
method: Add multi-speaker background speech; document source/mix level.

label: B05 · Fan/hum
method: Add steady fan/AC low-frequency noise at documented SNR.

label: B06 · Distant mic
method: Prefer simultaneous near/far recordings of one utterance. If re-recording from >1 m, verify a new reference and acknowledge delivery/room differences; gain reduction alone is insufficient.
inspect: Distance/room effect; paired only if the spoken take is shared

label: C01 · Speaker 1
method: Record a fluent speaker from region/background 1 with consent.

label: C02 · Speaker 2
method: Speaker from region/background 2; same microphone and script.

label: C03 · Speaker 3
method: Speaker from region/background 3; same microphone and script.

label: C04 · Speaker 4
method: Speaker from region/background 4; same microphone and script.

label: C05 · Speaker 5
method: Speaker from region/background 5; same microphone and script.

label: C06 · Speaker 6
method: Speaker from region/background 6; same microphone and script.

label: D01 · Hinglish
method: Record native code-switching exactly as said, using an agreed code-mix reference.

label: D02 · Hinglish
method: Mix Hindi grammar and English finance words.

label: D03 · Hinglish
method: Test English verb embedded in Hindi request.

label: D04 · Telugu mix
method: Bilingual Telugu speaker; verify output language configuration.

label: D05 · Telugu mix
method: Natural Telugu-English speaker; record exact spoken form.

label: D06 · Hinglish
method: Test code-switching plus a financially important negation.

label: E01 · 15 vs 50
method: Clear number contrast; flag both numbers and negation.
inspect: BUY quantity 15; 50 is rejected; preserve negation scope

label: E02 · Large amount
input_or_source: “My balance is one lakh twenty-five thousand rupees.”
method: Expected entity INR 125000; choose reference orthography.

label: E03 · Decimal
input_or_source: “The NAV is one hundred and twelve point five.”
method: Expected numeric value 112.5.

label: E04 · Date
input_or_source: “My SIP is due on the twenty-third of November.”
method: Expected month/day: November 23. Do not require a year supplied only in metadata. If scoring a complete date, say the year aloud and update the reference.

label: E05 · Synthetic ID
input_or_source: “My reference number is six eight four two nine one.”
method: Set expected sequence 684291; label as fictional.

label: E06 · Trade action
input_or_source: “Sell fifty shares of HDFC Bank at market price.”
method: Expected action SELL, qty 50, entity HDFC Bank.

label: F01 · KYC
method: Record clear phrase with KYC acronym.

label: F02 · UCC
method: Pronounce letters U-C-C.

label: F03 · ISIN
input_or_source: “Can you check the ISIN for this stock?”
method: Pronounce ISIN naturally, document intended spoken form.

label: F04 · NAV
input_or_source: “The NAV of my fund decreased yesterday.”
method: Pronounce NAV as it would be on a real call.

label: F05 · Company
input_or_source: “I hold shares of Motilal Oswal and HDFC Bank.”
method: Ensure exact spellings in references.

label: F06 · SIP
input_or_source: “I want to increase my SIP to five thousand rupees.”
method: Combine domain term and amount.

label: G01 · 2 sec
method: Very short command, trim leading silence without clipping.

label: G02 · 3 sec
method: Simple verb + entity.

label: G03 · 4 sec
method: Normal command with brief lead-in.

label: G04 · 15 sec
method: Write and read ~30–40 words; store exact spoken reference.

label: G05 · 20 sec
method: Write and read ~45–55 words with dates/amounts.

label: G06 · 25 sec
method: Write and read ~55–70 words with 2–3 entities.

label: H01 · 8 kHz
method: Low-pass/band-limit, convert to mono 8 kHz PCM WAV.

label: H02 · G.711 A-law
method: 8 kHz A-law encode/decode to WAV for API if needed.
inspect: Combined channel delta vs A02; codec-only delta vs I13

label: H03 · G.711 μ-law
method: 8 kHz μ-law encode/decode; ensure file accepted.
inspect: Combined channel delta vs A03; codec-only delta vs I14

label: H04 · Phone + noise
method: 8 kHz plus representative moderate background noise.

label: H05 · Phone + negation
method: 8 kHz A-law; preserve “not” in reference.

label: H06 · Phone + acronym
method: 8 kHz narrowband; evaluate “SIP”.

label: I01 · CORE · Silence
input_or_source: 3–5 seconds of digital silence in a valid supported WAV.
method: Empty reference. Verify decoding/duration; distinguish valid silence from a zero-byte upload.
inspect: False-transcription flag and inserted words; WER/CER N/A.

label: I02 · CORE · Non-speech
input_or_source: 3–5 seconds of fan/traffic sound with no intelligible voices.
method: Listen to verify no speech; record noise source/license. Empty reference.

label: I03 · CORE · Spontaneous correction
input_or_source: Example: “Buy fifteen—sorry, fifty shares. I changed my mind after checking the balance.”
method: Ask for a natural explanation; reference every actual word according to the frozen output-mode policy.
inspect: Faithful correction transcription; separately audit final quantity 50.

label: I04 · CORE · Pauses
input_or_source: Use A01 with a natural mid-sentence pause and trailing silence.
method: Preserve all speech; insert silence only between words if transforming. Record pause durations and shared source ID.
inspect: Missing tail, premature stopping or invented continuation.

label: I05 · CORE · Leading-zero ID
input_or_source: “My reference number is zero zero four two nine one.”
method: Expected ID is the string 004291; never convert IDs to integers.
inspect: Exact sequence and every leading zero.

label: I06 · CORE if feasible · Fast speech
input_or_source: A naturally faster reading of A03.
method: Use the same speaker and microphone; record actual duration and verify the new reference. Do not assume a speed effect is isolated from delivery.

label: I07 · CORE · Simple English
input_or_source: “Please close the window before you leave the room.”
method: Quiet, ordinary speech with no finance terms, numbers or acronyms.

label: I08 · CORE · Simple Hindi
input_or_source: “कृपया जाने से पहले खिड़की बंद कर दीजिए।”
method: Natural Hindi speaker, quiet setup, human-verified native-script reference.

label: I09 · CONDITIONAL CORE · Telugu control
method: Use the same competent bilingual speaker/settings as D04/D05; verify wording with that speaker.
inspect: Separate basic Telugu difficulty from code-switching difficulty.

label: I10 · CONTROL · Second source, 20 dB
input_or_source: A03 + the same traffic noise used for B01–B03.
method: Mix at 20 dB active-speech SNR with no clipping; document noise segment.

label: I11 · CONTROL · Second source, 10 dB
method: Change only SNR to 10 dB.

label: I12 · CONTROL · Second source, 0 dB
method: Change only SNR to 0 dB; prevent hard clipping.
inspect: High-noise behavior across more than one utterance.

label: I13 · CONTROL · PCM for H02
input_or_source: A02 converted to band-limited 8 kHz PCM before G.711.
method: Use precisely the pre-codec source from which H02 is encoded.
inspect: H02 minus I13 isolates added A-law processing.

label: I14 · CONTROL · PCM for H03
input_or_source: A03 converted to band-limited 8 kHz PCM before G.711.
method: Use precisely the pre-codec source from which H03 is encoded.
inspect: H03 minus I14 isolates added μ-law processing.

label: T01
method: Verify one lakh twenty-five thousand four hundred fifty, or acceptable equivalent.
inspect: Verify one lakh twenty-five thousand four hundred fifty, or acceptable equivalent.

label: T02
method: Verify integer and paise/decimal are spoken correctly; document convention.
inspect: Verify integer and paise/decimal are spoken correctly; document convention.

label: T03
method: Listen for correct date and year; no missing or swapped digit.
inspect: Listen for correct date and year; no missing or swapped digit.

label: T04
method: Check percent, decimal and implied sign.
inspect: Check percent, decimal and implied sign.

label: T05
method: Check both amounts and order, especially zero and thousand.
inspect: Check both amounts and order, especially zero and thousand.

label: T06
method: K-Y-C pronounced intelligibly; no invented expansion.
inspect: K-Y-C pronounced intelligibly; no invented expansion.

label: T07

inspect: U-C-C distinct; listen for letter confusion.

label: T08
method: I-F-S-C or accepted domain pronunciation; mark consistency.
inspect: I-F-S-C or accepted domain pronunciation; mark consistency.

label: T09
method: N-A-V / NAV according to intended voice convention, plus amount.
inspect: N-A-V / NAV according to intended voice convention, plus amount.

label: T10
method: SIP pronunciation and amount, no truncation.
inspect: SIP pronunciation and amount, no truncation.

label: T11
input_or_source: “आपका SIP successfully process हो गया है।”
method: Check both Hindi and English articulation, no voice collapse.
inspect: Check both Hindi and English articulation, no voice collapse.

label: T12
input_or_source: “Aapka portfolio balance abhi update hua hai.”
method: Pair with T36, which has identical wording in Devanagari/mixed script. Keep voice, meaning and supported language configuration comparable; record settings.
inspect: Pair with T36, which has identical wording in Devanagari/mixed script. Keep voice, meaning and supported language configuration comparable; record settings.

label: T13
method: Check smooth switches, no skipped Hindi or acronym.
inspect: Check smooth switches, no skipped Hindi or acronym.

label: T14

inspect: Check Hindi phrase within English sentence.

label: T15
input_or_source: “मुझे account statement email पर भेज दीजिए।”
method: Check clarity, boundary pauses and completeness.
inspect: Check clarity, boundary pauses and completeness.

label: T16
input_or_source: “Your HDFC Bank shares have been credited.”
method: Company name and acronym; avoid wrong extra syllables.
inspect: Company name and acronym; avoid wrong extra syllables.

label: T17
method: Company name stress and syllables.

label: T18
method: Place-name pronunciation.

input_or_source: “Your transaction with Saraswati Finance is complete.”

method: Technical initialism and surrounding speech rhythm.
inspect: Technical initialism and surrounding speech rhythm.

method: Extend to ~75 words; note breath/pause consistency.

method: Listen for interrogative prosody and natural ending.

method: Check emphasis on “not”; no dangerous omission.
inspect: Check emphasis on “not”; no dangerous omission.

label: T28 · Punctuation
input_or_source: “First, check your balance. Next, review your transactions. Finally, confirm the payment.”

inspect: Check pause placement and list flow.

label: T29 · Ambiguity
input_or_source: “I will read the report now. I read it yesterday.”

inspect: OPTIONAL: appropriate upbeat delivery. Do not require exaggerated emotion or fail acceptable neutral delivery solely on preference.

label: T31 · CORE · Simple English
input_or_source: “Your request has been received. We will contact you tomorrow.”
method: Baseline intelligibility, naturalness and complete content without numeric/acronym challenges.
inspect: Baseline intelligibility, naturalness and complete content without numeric/acronym challenges.

label: T32 · CORE · Simple Hindi
input_or_source: “आपका अनुरोध मिल गया है। हम कल आपसे संपर्क करेंगे।”
method: Use an appropriate fixed voice/language and a Hindi-competent listener; check complete ordinary speech.
inspect: Use an appropriate fixed voice/language and a Hindi-competent listener; check complete ordinary speech.

label: T33 · CORE · Very short response
method: Verify audible nonempty speech and intact beginning/ending. Do not inflate duration with silence to improve RTF.
inspect: Verify audible nonempty speech and intact beginning/ending. Do not inflate duration with silence to improve RTF.

label: T34 · CORE · Negative value
method: Require a negative value, 2.5, and percent. Predeclare acceptable “minus”/“negative” variants.
inspect: Require a negative value, 2.5, and percent. Predeclare acceptable “minus”/“negative” variants.

label: T35 · CORE · Leading-zero identifier
method: Listener writes the heard digits before seeing expected text. Require string 004291; preserve leading zeros. Define acceptable repetition/grouping conventions.
inspect: Listener writes the heard digits before seeing expected text. Require string 004291; preserve leading zeros. Define acceptable repetition/grouping conventions.

input_or_source: “आपका portfolio balance अभी update हुआ है।”

inspect: Same words/meaning as T12. Compare native/mixed script with Romanized Hindi; log routing/language choices and pronunciation differences.

input_or_source: “Your available balance is one lakh twenty-five thousand four hundred fifty rupees.”
method: Same model, voice and settings as T01. Compare amount correctness, naturalness, latency and RTF; this measures preprocessing benefit.
